workflow_feedback.brief: reader_brief_v08.md, steps a–d performed; complete reading.tex was written before this detailed return.
workflow_feedback.isolation: Only the assigned page, its packet-linked witnesses/preambles/context/doubt index, and the supplied notation snapshot were read. No current reader output, main decision, other page image or external source was inspected.
workflow_feedback.H_drawings: H.tex contains no drawing command or page-specific drawing reference. No unrelated drawing directory contents were inspected.
workflow_feedback.omitted_emission: The first attempted output of crop 13 was discarded by the code-mode image output limit in the call that displayed crops 11 and 12. The image itself was not visible to this reader then. It was emitted again alone and actually viewed once. No source was recropped for this event.
workflow_feedback.crop_process: One batch of 15 original-image crops, each made once. Every crop is 3000 px wide, LANCZOS enlarged, autocontrasted and sharpened. Margins were rotated within the same crop operation and automatically trimmed. No OCR, text-recognition, PDF text-layer extraction, external research or compilation was used.
clipping_notes: Crop 01 cuts the upper tip of the large enclosing parenthesis as context; the Pi pair, cancelled mark and lower annotation targets remain present.

Crop 11 starts at x=290 and clips part of the separate (28) label to its left. The complete surviving label was already included as overlapping context in the simultaneously generated crop 13 and was read there; no replacement crop was made.

Crop 14 starts at y=2050 and clips the upper tips of the high inserted x,y comparables phrase. Its complete lettering is present in half b and in crop 12; the placement brace and lower cancellation are present in crop 14. No additional crop was made.
Some adjoining line fragments are cut at the edges of tight crops 06, 07, 08, 10, 12 and 15. They are contextual fragments, not omitted transcription targets.

Crop 15 reaches both the physical right edge and the full lower source edge. Descenders in the final main NB meet the photographed lower boundary; no strokes below that boundary were supplied. The final C and its surrounding white area remain visible.

The rotation of crop 02 leaves residual slant and some white triangular padding because neighbouring main-text strokes and a border remnant survive the automatic trim. The target note is present; the enlargement is less spatially economical than intended. Crop 13 also retains a strip of photographed black edge.
workflow_feedback.notation_policy: Recurring Pi case uncertainty is marked at its first page occurrence only. Fonts and uncertainty-only alternatives with the same H first reading do not add H differences. H editorial notes on vertical layout and the rewritten lower clauses were explicitly credited.
workflow_feedback.proof_checks: No mathematical proof check, independent re-proof or computation was performed. check_events is empty.
workflow_feedback.validation: Validated required JSON values, original-image bounds, unique coverage of all 31 C doubt identifiers, and the match of 19 unresolved entries to 19 unsure macros. This was metadata validation, not mathematical checking.
